description: Explicit hypothetical advanced-tax and covenant source proposals. Actual FIFO competition is required only where competing eligible old vintages and partial capacity were observed. No benchmark task or difficulty qualification is implied.

cases.name: Cash tax, deferred tax and covenant liquidity
cases.mechanism: The stated accelerated tax vintages, annual interest limitation and one-year loss expiry create cash-versus-book differences while the covenant reserve enters, cures and transfers real cash.

cases.name: Competing old interest vintages under a tighter cap
cases.mechanism: A ten-percent EBITDA deduction capacity retains multiple old interest carry vintages. Require positive competing old buckets and actual partial FIFO consumption, not merely an aggregate carry balance.

cases.name: Two-year loss carry creates eligible-vintage competition
cases.mechanism: The stated two-year NOL carry keeps both earlier annual loss vintages eligible at the third settlement. Require actual capacity-limited FIFO competition; do not claim NOL expiry in this three-year case.

cases.name: Zero-rate Loan A under a tighter interest allowance
cases.mechanism: Loan A is explicitly zero-rate and the EBITDA interest allowance is ten percent. Require real interest carry creation and old-carry consumption from the other facilities together with loss expiry, gross deferred tax and a measured lock/cure.

cases.name: Higher coverage covenant with year-end tax effects
cases.mechanism: A 1.50 quarterly coverage threshold changes lock duration while current cash tax and noncash deferred expense follow their separate accounting paths.

cases.name: Reserve funded only while distributions are locked
cases.mechanism: The explicit zero normal and five-payment trapped reserve changes liquidity allocation. Tax attributes and full deferred recognition remain active; unlocked normal reserve is actually zero.

cases.name: Cross-year commissioning and an interrupted cure
cases.mechanism: Twelve construction months shift equipment service, tax depreciation and operating cash generation into the second year. Require one-year NOL expiry and an actual failed test after one successful test, followed by a cure.

cases.name: Larger funded startup loss with competing NOL vintages
cases.mechanism: Additional paid-in equity explicitly funds the larger startup expense. Two-year loss carry preserves multiple eligible old NOL buckets and requires measured FIFO competition at a later positive settlement.

cases.name: Acquisition and tax service in different calendar years
cases.mechanism: Refresh equipment is paid in year two but first enters service in year three. Tax basis carries pre-service cost while cash funding, deferred balances and the stated larger reserve/covenant interact.

cases.name: Both equipment tax vintages complete within the horizon
cases.mechanism: Refresh payment in month nine and service in month ten activate all three service-calendar-year tax depreciation steps and later exhaust its shorter book basis; original equipment remains a separate vintage.
